author: GamerGeek01
quote: I disliked it so much I uninstalled it and went back to Crimson Desert that cost just 135m. You had billions to spend on this ? I don’t understand what happened with all the money. GTA is about raw crime not family planning. Only the mods could save this game. The storyline is a complete disaster. This may be the last of the GTA series. Bring back Dan Houser to write the risky and funny scripts. Although after this I doubt he would step back in. It’s the worst gaming flop in history. And your sales are based on pre launch hype. Not good enough for something that should have been respected. You played it safe and poured tons of feminist ideologies in to it. It’s a game not built for men. It’s a game that hasn’t been built for GTA fans. It’s a game built to promote modern social guidelines where men pander to women. Shame on you for doing this. And lastly where’s the fun ? Is that a crime too these days. I utterly hate it.
